places-ubsu-nur-oroku-shinaa-2.story: The stops in between: Tes River, Oroku-Shinaa and back through Tes River. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It crosses from Russia into Mongolia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
